headline: Margin lead sustains; growth story intact

highlights: While EBITDA dipped 19% YoY (broadly in-line), Star appeared confident of improved performance in H2FY27 citing – 1) 12– 13% YoY volume growth expectation (vs. 3% in H1); 2) no major rise in fuel cost (citing improved supply of FSA coal); and 3) benefits of cement price hikes.
Accordingly, we trim our valuation multiple to 10x FY28E EV/EBITDA (vs 11x earlier).
Performance in-line Star’s Q2FY27 EBITDA was in-line with our estimate.

Highlights: 1) volume grew just 2% YoY (3% ahead of expectation) owing to the impact from heavy rains in key markets. 2) Realisation was down 1.9% QoQ vs. our 1% drop estimate. 3) Variable cost/t surprised, falling 2.4% QoQ (being 2% below forecast). 4) Fixed cost disappointed (staff plus ‘other expenses’, collectively rose 12% YoY; 9% ahead of expectation).
